integrity: Standalone standard-library exact rational verifier checks 420 finite cases; analytical proof provides all-integer and asymptotic results, which finite enumeration does not prove.
scientific_limitations: Finite symmetric concentration only; classical Dirichlet-multinomial law and general factorial moments previously known. Historical uniqueness of the sign/limit-order classification not established; no nonsymmetric, general stochastic-association, or joint varying-parameter rate claimed.
title: One-crossing reinforced occupancy covariance, exact zeros, and noncommuting critical fractions
